title: Unexported getStore function causes build warning and type bypass
requirement: MockWorkflowRepository must export standard query getters for store entities
actual_behavior: uc2/longitudinal/[subjectRef]/page.tsx casts (MockWorkflowRepository as any).getStore?.() to access store sessions because getStore is private.
expected_behavior: MockWorkflowRepository exports getSessionsBySubject(subjectRef: string) or getStore() cleanly.
risk: Build warning, runtime failure if getStore is renamed, and violation of strict TypeScript typing.
recommended_fix: Export getSessionsBySubject(subjectRef: string) from MockWorkflowRepository and call it in page.tsx.
acceptance_test: npx next build completes with 0 warnings and longitudinal page renders historical sessions without type casting.

title: Zero automated unit, component, or E2E test files exist in workspace
requirement: Master prompt mandates test suite execution and evidence validation for P0 flows
actual_behavior: No unit, component, or Playwright E2E spec files are implemented in the project.
expected_behavior: Automated test suites exist for session workflow, QC rules, review overrides, and E2E scenarios 01-13.
risk: Inability to perform automated regression testing, leading to silent breakage during maintenance.
recommended_fix: Implement Vitest/Jest unit tests for services and Playwright E2E specs under apps/web-portal/e2e/.
acceptance_test: Running pnpm test and pnpm exec playwright test passes all scenarios with clean reports.

title: Route-level RBAC is omitted in authenticated layout wrapper
requirement: Role guard applies at BOTH route and action level according to Section 11 of master prompt
actual_behavior: (authenticated)/layout.tsx only checks isAuthenticated and does not enforce canAccessRoute(user.role, pathname).
expected_behavior: (authenticated)/layout.tsx checks canAccessRoute and redirects unauthorized roles to /dashboard or shows access denied.
risk: A logged-in patient or technician could directly type an administrative or clinical review URL and access pages that forget to include <RoleGuard>.
recommended_fix: Call canAccessRoute(user.role, pathname) in DashboardLayout and block access if unauthorized.
acceptance_test: Navigating directly to /admin/users while logged in as a patient returns an Access Denied alert.

title: UC1 calibration route is a 145-byte empty placeholder stub
requirement: UC1 calibration must reuse or render the canonical calibration wizard component
actual_behavior: Page renders empty default content without rendering CalibrationWizard or redirecting to canonical calibration.
expected_behavior: Route redirects to /sessions/[sessionId]/calibration or embeds CalibrationWizard.
risk: Dead-end navigation if a user accesses the UC1 specific calibration URL.
recommended_fix: Reuse canonical calibration page component or add explicit redirect.
acceptance_test: Accessing /uc1/calibration/S-001 opens the interactive calibration wizard.

title: Missing secondary canonical subroutes
requirement: Canonical route specification lists full route tree including detail and sub-feature routes
expected_behavior: Detail pages exist for devices, protocols, and feedback training candidates.
risk: User cannot view granular details for specific hardware devices or protocol specifications.
recommended_fix: Add missing detail page files under their respective App Router folders.
acceptance_test: Clicking a device item opens /devices/DEV-001 with complete specification details.

title: Use of Math.random() in MockCalibrationService violates deterministic mock rules
requirement: Mock services must return deterministic fixtures to ensure repeatable testing
expected_behavior: Calibration amplitude calculation uses a deterministic hash or fixed fixture value.
risk: Flaky test assertions and inconsistent UI state during automated audits.
recommended_fix: Replace Math.random() with a deterministic seed or hash function.
acceptance_test: Multiple calls to runCalibrationStep return identical peakAmplitude for the same input.

title: TypeScript type safety bypasses via 'as any' in feedback page
requirement: Code must adhere to strict TypeScript without unjustified type assertions
actual_behavior: State resolution is cast using 'as any' multiple times when handling status changes.
expected_behavior: Strongly typed enum or type guard is used to handle MLAdjudicationStatus values.
risk: Potential runtime TypeError if invalid status strings are assigned to state.
recommended_fix: Use MLAdjudicationStatus type directly in useState and event handlers.
acceptance_test: Feedback adjudication page compiles with zero 'as any' casts.

title: PNPM CLI version requirement mismatch with host Node.js version
requirement: Build tooling commands execute seamlessly across standard developer environments
evidence: npx pnpm --version output: ERROR: pnpm requires at least Node.js v22.13, host is v18.19.1
actual_behavior: Running npx pnpm fails on host environment due to Node v18 vs pnpm v9+ incompatibility.
expected_behavior: Package scripts run via npm/npx or pnpm configured for Node v18.
risk: Developer confusion when attempting to run pnpm scripts directly.
recommended_fix: Add 'engines' field in package.json specifying Node >= 18.0.0 or pin pnpm version via corepack.
acceptance_test: npm run build / npm run lint execute cleanly without toolchain errors.
